name: Gianluca Rossi
bio:
Gianluca Rossi's career began not on the track, but in the bustling offices of a Milanese accounting firm. After earning his degree in Economics and Business, he spent several years honing his skills in human resources, but he longed for something more exciting. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, Gianluca saw an opportunity to combine his professional expertise with his passion when a position opened up at Ferrari AF Corse.

He's a firm believer in structured, fair, and transparent management, ensuring that every team member feels valued and supported. Gianluca is known for his calm demeanor and ability to resolve conflicts effectively. He is a stalwart of the HR department and is known to have an eye for finding the best talent.

Gianluca is driven by the belief that a happy, motivated team is a winning team. He emphasizes continuous training and development, and promotes a culture of open communication. His dedication to finding and nurturing talent is a key asset to Ferrari AF Corse, ensuring the team remains competitive.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with slight recession at the temples.
physical.description: A stocky man with a kind face and a slightly weary expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously jotting down notes during meetings.
Has a framed picture of Enzo Ferrari on his desk, which he occasionally polishes.
Insists on having a strong espresso every morning at exactly 10:00 AM.
